_comment: Golden fixture for the supervisor's should_mint decision — input {minter_present, url, ssh_host, ssh_port} -> the mint verdict. Read by BOTH the Go runner (cmd/shed-host-agent/golden_test.go:TestGoldenShouldMint, via shouldMint(SharedDeps, ServerTarget)) and the Rust runner (crates/shed-host-agent/src/supervisor.rs tests::golden_should_mint, via should_mint(&SharedDeps, &ServerTarget)). Pins the load-bearing rule: mint iff a minter is present AND the target has a non-empty ssh_host AND ssh_port>0 AND the api_url is https (the scheme, case-insensitive — NOT tls-fingerprint presence, NOT ssh_port alone). Mirrors supervisor_test.go:TestShouldMint (7 cases).
